title: The Vow of the Old Mill House
author: Jude Thornbury
blurb: Ines Almeida, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then the person behind a decade of letters moves in next door — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
